cs.t: I have a RoboRock Q Revo that I got when it was on sale at Costco a while back. I was a bit wary that it was a Chinese brand and uses a cloud connection for control (no local option). However, it seems miles ahead of iRobot's offerings. I would not get a model with a camera though. The LIDAR version seems to work just fine for navigation purposes.
